description: Implement AudioCaptureBackend for Windows using WASAPI in loopback mode. Captures system audio from any output device. Handles: device enumeration via IMMDeviceEnumerator, shared-mode loopback stream, sample rate conversion to match encoder expectations, device-change notifications (IMMNotificationClient), and mixed mic+system capture for commentary mode. Target: < 5ms audio latency, zero-glitch under sustained recording.
title: WASAPI loopback audio capture
